newsitem.title: USA: Allin CFO Jon VanAmringe to leave company.
newsitem.headline: Allin CFO Jon VanAmringe to leave company.

text.p: Allin Communications Corp said Monday that its chief financial officer, Jon VanAmringe, is leaving the company to pursue other opportunities.
It said that Dean Praskach has been promoted to vice-president of finance and will assume VanAmringe's duties.

Allin supplies interactive television systems to the cruise line industry, proprietary media and information platforms to the digital imaging industry and sports-related marketing programs through its International Sports Marketing division.
